title: HTML-to-Image Cross-Origin Font Taint
symptom: DOM-to-PNG export fails with security error or blank text when custom fonts are loaded from external origins
root_cause: html-to-image tries to serialize stylesheets; cross-origin external font files without CORS cause security canvas tainting
solution: Use baseOptions with fontEmbedCSS: '' and embed all critical fonts as inline base64 data URIs

title: React 19 motion useAnimate icon ref typing
symptom: TS2769: Property 'ref' does not exist on type IntrinsicAttributes when using motion.create(Icon) with useAnimate scope in React 19
solution: Wrap the icon in a span with ref={scope} instead of using motion.create(Icon) with ref
